applicableAreas: Consolidated Site Plan Application form, Project Information section
findings.comment: Legal description on the consolidated site plan application form contains an error. The form states 'LOT 1 MECEY SUBD, V.73, P.6' but should read 'LOT 1 MECEY SUBD, V.73, P.76'. The correct page reference is Page 76, not Page 6, as confirmed by the recorded plat in Sheet 2 and the cover sheet legal description. This must be corrected to match the recorded final plat.

Legal description acreage is inconsistent across documents and must be reconciled. Site plan cover sheet shows 2.16 acres; TCAD tax certificate shows 2.1970 acres; facts.md deed reference shows 2.158 acres; COA GIS parcel shows 2.111 acres. The controlling acreage must be determined and all references updated for consistency. If GIS acreage (2.111 ac) is controlling, impervious cover calculations based on 2.16 acres may require recalculation.

applicableAreas: Consolidated Site Plan Application, cover sheet
findings.comment: TCAD parcel ID designations are inconsistent. Application form lists tax parcel number as '308163' while the TCAD tax certificate account number is '04-0610-0252-0000' and the standard 10-digit parcel ID is '0406100252'. All references must be cross-referenced to the current TCAD records and any discrepancies explained.

applicableAreas: Consolidated Site Plan Application, cover sheet, TCAD documentation
findings.comment: TCAD parcel ID is not provided in the required 10-digit format. The application shows '308163' which is not in the standard 10-digit format (should be '0406100252'). All TCAD parcel IDs must be corrected to the full 10-digit format per the Reviewer Convention threshold.

applicableAreas: Recorded plat, site plan sheets (grading, drainage, utility plans)
findings.comment: Plat notes and easement restrictions may not be fully reflected on site plan sheets. The recorded Mecey Subdivision plat (Sheet 2) references easements including 25' Drainage Easement, 10' Water/Wastewater Easement, 3' Electric Easement, and 5' PUE. Additionally, facts.md identifies two critical recorded easements not depicted: Greenbelt Access & Use Easement (Instrument 2010070731, 0.31 acres, NE interior no-build zone) and City of Austin Drainage Easement (Instrument 2011021137, 0.130 acres, NE corner). Verify that all recorded easements are accurately depicted on the site plan, grading plan, and utility plans, and that no proposed structures or improvements conflict with easement restrictions, particularly the two undepicted no-build zones totaling ~0.44 acres.

The recorded deed showing the legal description of the property cannot be verified as included in the plan set. The application references deed Document 2019197883 (Special Warranty Deed, 2019-12-11) but the actual recorded deed document itself does not appear to be submitted as a separate sheet or included in the supplementary documents. The deed must be provided to verify coverage of the entire property and match against the legal description.
